religion_note: The 2012 census's religion question, answered for the 7,324 residents of ordinary dwellings, in the census's own thirteen answers.
ethnicity_note: Afrobarometer Round 9, a nationally representative sample of citizens of voting age. Regional shares are survey estimates, not census counts: they carry sampling error, and regions with fewer than 25 respondents are omitted rather than estimated. This region: 48 respondents. Fewer than 50 respondents, so this share is imprecise and should be read as indicative.
language_note: Which languages each person speaks, as the 2012 census asked the 7,083 residents of ordinary dwellings aged one year and over, several answers allowed: each share is the percentage of them who speak the language, so the shares add up to more than 100. Other languages include sign language.
population_note: The 2012 census counted 7,344 residents in the Autonomous Region of Príncipe (present and absent residents, in ordinary and collective dwellings). The one division drawn on this map carries 9,151 (OCHA's common operational dataset, 2022), 7% below this figure; its figure is for 2022, 2 years before this one.
sex_ratio_note: Men per 100 women among the residents the 2012 census counted.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from the 2012 census's ages of the 7,324 residents of ordinary dwellings.

religion_note: The 2012 census's religion question, answered for the 171,415 residents of ordinary dwellings, in the census's own thirteen answers.

ethnicity_note: Afrobarometer Round 9, a nationally representative sample of citizens of voting age. Regional shares are survey estimates, not census counts: they carry sampling error, and regions with fewer than 25 respondents are omitted rather than estimated. Pooled from the figures published for Norte Oeste, Centro Este and Sul Este, weighted by their published counts; the map draws them as one unit. The three are the survey's divisions of São Tomé island.
population_note: The sum of all 6 divisions drawn inside it, which all carry figures for 2022 from OCHA's common operational dataset. It replaces 193,380 for 2018, an older figure from Wikipedia.
sex_ratio_note: Men per 100 women among the residents the 2012 census counted.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from the 2012 census's ages of the 171,415 residents of ordinary dwellings.
